blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: أَلَاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَي أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ كُلُّ ضَعِيفٍ مُتَضَعِّفٍ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَي اللهِ لأَبَرَّهُ، وَأَهْلِ النَّارِ كُلُّ جَوَّاظٍ عُتُلٍّ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب قول الله تعالي واقسموا بالله... رقم:٦٦٥٧
blocks.tamil_translation: The Prophet ﷺ asked, “Shall I tell you who is of the people of Jannah?” (Then he himself began to answer) “Every weak and simple person who has made gentle humility and softness his nature in his dealings, his giving and taking, and his conduct, is of the people of Jannah; people regard him as weak. (But his connection with Allah Ta'ala is such that) if he swears an oath by Allah Ta'ala about some matter, saying, “This matter will happen exactly like this,” Allah Ta'ala gives importance to his oath and will certainly fulfil his matter.” (He asked) “Shall I tell you who is of the people of Jahannam?” (and then he himself answered) “Every person who hoards wealth, is miserly, hard-hearted and arrogant, is of the people of Jahannam” — Hazrat Harithah ibn Wahb (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِ النَّارِ: أَهْلُ النَّارِ كُلُّ جَعْظَرِيٍّ جَوٍّاظٍ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ جَمَّاعٍ مَنَّاعٍ، وَأَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الضُّعَفَاءُ الْمَغْلُوبُونَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٧٢١/١٠
